_note: CURATED FOR THE CAPSTONE from widely published public food-safety guidance (e.g. UK FSA, USDA FSIS). Not a substitute for a regulator's current chart. Temperatures in Celsius. Answers about cooking, holding or reheating must state the number from this chart, never only a description such as 'cooked through'.

entries.rule: Cook until the thickest part reaches at least 74C.
Cook minced meat to at least 71C throughout.
Cook egg dishes to at least 71C.
Reheat cooked leftovers until steaming hot, at least 74C, once only.
Once fermented, refrigerate the batter at 5C or below and use within 2 days.
After the 2-hour stand, refrigerate at 5C or below; do not leave dairy at room temperature longer.
Cool cooked rice and get it below 5C within 2 hours, or ferment it at once as the neeragaram card says; Bacillus cereus spores survive cooking.
